case.question: How do I switch the EVK between USB power and a wall adapter?

result.question: How do I switch the EVK between USB power and a wall adapter?
result.answer: To switch the EVK between voltage sources, use Jumper 3 (JMP 3) [EVK-v1.1-p012-1]. Placing the jumper in the first position enables USB Type-C as the input voltage source, while the second position enables the +5V Adapter as the voltage source [EVK-v1.1-p012-1]. You must place the Power Input Jumper (JMP 3) according to the input power supply being used [EVK-v1.1-p016-1].

case.question: How can I tell that the module has joined the mobile network?
case.expected_behavior: Network status indication pin/LED (NET_STATUS); on the EVK the NETLIGHT LED.

result.question: How can I tell that the module has joined the mobile network?
result.answer: The C16QS module provides an open-drain GPIO signal to indicate the status of RF communication [HW-v5.3-p039-2]. Users can utilize pins 21 or 75 as a network indicator, ensuring only one is used while the other remains floating [HW-v5.3-p041-1]. The brightness of this indicator can be adjusted by modifying the current limiting resistor, up to a maximum of 40 mA [HW-v5.3-p041-1]. Additionally, the module enters an idle mode once it has registered to the network successfully [HW-v5.3-p016-1].
